ops.title: _tool_output() is annotated -> str but returns evt.tool_response raw, so Task/Agent PostToolUse hands a dict to re.search and nudge_multiagent_synthesis raises TypeError
ops.description:
STILL PRESENT AT HEAD (0.51.2, 251c6f2). Found in the field 2026-08-29 on yasyf-forge-studio, deployed cc-notes 0.51.1.

plugin/capt-hook/hooks/record.py:1067-1068

    def _tool_output(evt: BaseHookEvent) -> str:
        return getattr(evt, "tool_response", None) or ""

The annotation promises str. `tool_response` is whatever the harness put there, and for a Task/Agent PostToolUse it is a **dict**. `or ""` only substitutes on a FALSY value, so a non-empty dict passes straight through and the annotation is simply false.

plugin/capt-hook/hooks/record.py:1325, in nudge_multiagent_synthesis:

    if not VERDICT_LANGUAGE_RE.search(_tool_output(evt)) or fired_this_turn(evt):

    TypeError: expected string or bytes-like object, got 'dict'

The hook is registered `only_if Tool(names=('Task', 'Agent'))`, i.e. it fires on exactly the event shape that carries a dict. This is not a rare path — it is the ONLY path this hook runs on, so it raises every time two or more subagents have been counted and an investigation is not already open.

VERBATIM TRACEBACK, from the host log at ~/Library/Caches/captain-hook/host-v1/capt-hookd.log:

    File "/Users/yasyf/.daemonkit/tools/capt-hook/12.22.3/capt-hook/lib/python3.13/site-packages/captain_hook/dispatch.py", line 33, in run_handler
        return entry.handler(evt) if entry.handler else run_declarative(entry.spec, evt)
    File "/Users/yasyf/.claude/plugins/cache/cc-notes/cc-notes/0.51.1/capt-hook/hooks/record.py", line 1325, in nudge_multiagent_synthesis
        if not VERDICT_LANGUAGE_RE.search(_tool_output(evt)) or fired_this_turn(evt):
    TypeError: expected string or bytes-like object, got 'dict'

SECOND CALLER AT RISK: _minted_id (record.py:1075-1079) does `text = _tool_output(evt) or _event_error(evt)` and then string work on `text`. Same dict reaches it by the same route. Fixing only line 1325 leaves that one live, which is why the fix belongs in _tool_output rather than at the call site.

WHY THIS IS FILED P1 RATHER THAN AS A COSMETIC TYPE BUG — a type error in this repo became a wedged daemon in another one.

The worker process that raised this TypeError was a capt-hook hook worker owned by captain-hook's host daemon. It died on the traceback. When captain-hook's deployment was later asked to converge, daemonkit's shutdown had to settle that worker, and the child's own settlement ladder timed out unproven and published ReapUndetermined for it (daemonkit control.go:58-60). daemonkit's owned-child loop (own.go:317-320) turned that terminal into a fault, and serve.go:278-284 responded by abandoning the shutdown and calling park() — deliberately holding the flock until a drain signal arrives. Nothing in the upgrade path sends that signal, so captain-hook's host sat alive-but-socketless and its deployment could not be superseded. Recovering it took a SIGKILL via `launchctl kickstart -k`.

So the causal chain is: dict reaches re.search here -> hook worker dies -> its exit cannot be proven -> daemonkit abandons shutdown and parks -> captain-hook's daemon is unusable until force-killed. The daemonkit half is being filed separately against daemonkit (the park-with-no-signal is its own defect, and a robust daemon should survive a worker that dies badly). But this TypeError is the reproducible first domino, it is independently wrong, and it is the cheapest of the three to fix.

ops.text: _tool_output() returns a str for every event shape, including a dict tool_response, so its -> str annotation is true
nudge_multiagent_synthesis survives a Task/Agent PostToolUse whose tool_response is a dict, with a regression test carrying a dict payload
Every other _tool_output caller that does string work — _minted_id at record.py:1078 included — is checked against the same dict shape
